summary: HOTA V7f - ACT: C1 +0.34 n.s., C4 +2.01 sig., C3 -0.65 n.s., C5 +10.06 sig. MOTA V7f - ACT: ACT significantly higher in C4 (-4.35) and C3 (-3.62); C1 +5.00 and C5 +13.24 n.s. ACT - host HOTA: C1 +0.57 n.s., C4 +0.27 sig., C3 +8.56 sig., C5 +36.24 sig. Mechanism: ACT's thresholds are absolute scores; with halved scores Q1 <= 0.5 in every frame that has candidates above 0.1 (the 251 C4 frames with tau_high=0.6 have none), so ACT always takes tau_H1=0.3 (=0.6 on the original scale), i.e. the host's own operating point for OC-SORT.
